project.title: Gamer Girl
project.description: Requested phone wallpaper illustration by a friend drawn traditionally with pens and alcohol markers. Features a pink-haired girl with her hobbies surrounding her including Mobile Legends, drawing and reading.

project.title: Chibi AOT Trio
project.description: Cross hatching drawing of chibi Eren, chibi Mikasa, and chibi Armin from the animated comedic shorts of the original Attack on Titan (AOT) anime/manga. This version of the AOT is much lighter than the themes of the original. It's a breather of a show that reimagines the characters as high school students, teacher and staff instead of soldiers. Both the original and the animated shorts were really enjoyable and inspired me to learn and draw using hatching techniques.

project.title: Violet Evergarden
project.description: Digital art of Violet Evergarden using Microsoft Paint. Violet is a war survivor making a living through wrting letters that connect people after her special person supposedly died in that tragedy. Her story of finding her purpose and living a happy life after the war touched me to draw her.
